title: rclpy node using 100% CPU: spin_once(timeout_sec=0) loops, timers, MultiThreadedExecutor, Cyclone DDS and EventsExecutor, measured
excerpt: An idle rclpy node hit 100% CPU only with a spin_once(timeout_sec=0) loop. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical: timer and subscriber cost from 10 to 1000 Hz, MultiThreadedExecutor using a full core and dropping messages on Fast DDS, Cyclone DDS, and EventsExecutor.
